about: The activity derivation rule, as cases. The rule is evaluated twice — once
on the server for work rows (work.DeriveActivity) and once in the client for
session rows (web/src/lib/activity.ts) — so it is written down once, here,
and both test suites read this file. A change to the rule that is made in
only one of the two fails on the other side.
A case with no turn is a work with no session, or one whose session sits
between turns: for a work item the two are the same nothing.

cases.name: a closed work, whatever its old session is doing
a stopped work, whatever its old session is doing
an active work whose turn is producing output
a running turn outranks a declared wait
a turn blocked on a question
a turn blocked on a permission request
permission outranks question: it cannot be answered late
a turn parked on background work
a question outranks a background wait: one of them can be acted on
an idle turn on a work waiting for the user
an idle turn on a work waiting for its children
an active work with no session at all
a wait with no session is still a wait
